5:8.note: 'His prophet' for man of God; Israel after king omitted.

8:8.note: 'Ask the word of the LORD from him'; direct speech framing plus.

8:25.note: Eleventh year for twelfth; shana minus.

8:28.note: Joram as subject (Ahaziah 'with' omitted); Edom for Aram.

9:14.note: 'Son of Jehoshaphat' omitted; 'with him' plus; Edom for Aram.

9:17.note: 'Horsemen' for shif'at; watchman repeated as plus.

9:34.note: 'Entered to eat and drink'; na minus.

10:5.note: Titles rendered as nouns; plus 'over us all'; le'mor minus.

10:17.note: 'Destroyed all that was found in the house of Ahab'.

10:22.note: 'Treasurer'; last clause 'he brought out vestments for them' minus.

10:24.note: Plus 'at the gate' and 'three hundred' (380 men).

11:2.note: Plus verb 'and hid him'; ketiv/qere joint.

11:11.note: 'They surrounded the altar and the king's house'.

11:12.note: 'Put the crown on his head'; anointing before enthronement.

11:17.note: 'Priest' plus; king in first pair omitted.

12:16.note: Plus 'money of the repair'; 'into their hand' minus.

13:10.note: Plus 'son of Jehu'; thirteen years for sixteen.

13:17.note: Plus 'to him', 'arrow', object 'them'; Edom for Aram.

13:23.note: Repeated 'with' and LORD plus; 'until then' for 'until now'.

14:10.note: 'Do not stir up' for 'why stir up'.

14:11.note: Amaziah king of Judah anticipated as plus; 'each other' plus.

14:13.note: 'Son of Jehoash son of Ahaziah' minus; ketiv/qere joint.

15:12.note: 'Fulfilled was the word' for 'that was the word'.

15:25.note: Ketiv/qere joint; Argob and Arieh as 'Arbog and Ani'.

16:18.note: Plus 'of the LORD' and 'gate' for MT 'king' in 'king's entrance'.

17:23.note: Plus 'the LORD' and 'them'; MT 'his servants' not rendered.

17:34.note: Plus 'because they left the LORD'; 'former customs' rendered 'custom of the nations'.

17:38.note: 'Forget' rendered 'err'; 'other gods' rendered 'gods of the peoples'.

17:41.note: Plus 'who dwelt in Samaria' and several 'also'.

19:27.note: Going out and coming in reordered.

20:4.note: Syriac reads 'court' (qere); 'Isaiah had not gone out'.

21:4.note: MT 'of the LORD' after 'house' not rendered.

21:7.note: Plus 'in the house of the LORD' and 'there'.

22:6.note: Syriac repeats 'let them pay it' (from MT 22:5); plus 'of the LORD'.

22:13.note: Plus 'all'; 'written concerning us' rendered 'written in it'.

22:17.note: 'Shall not be quenched' not rendered; plus 'says the LORD and I will destroy you'.

23:16.note: 'Man of God' rendered 'his prophet of God'.

23:18.note: Plus 'let no man approach the grave and no man'.
